units.tr: To the Divine Emperor Caesar Matthias, crowned by God, faithful Vicar of Christ, gentle, greatest, beneficent and peaceable; most sacred Prince of the Romans; most invincible and most glorious ruler of the Germans, Gauls and Italians; universal Advocate of the Holy Catholic Church; pious, fortunate, renowned, victorious and triumphant, ever august; most serene King of Hungary, Bohemia, Dalmatia, Croatia, Slavonia, Rama, Serbia, Galicia, Lodomeria, Cumania, Bulgaria, etc.; most illustrious Archprince, Elector and Archcupbearer of the Holy Roman Empire; Archduke of Austria; Grand Duke of Burgundy and Silesia; Duke of Lorraine, Brabant, Styria, Carinthia, Carniola, Limburg, Luxembourg, Guelders, Württemberg, etc.; Landgrave of Alsace, Breisgau, Sundgau, Nellenburg, etc.; Margrave of Moravia, Lusatia, Istria, Burgau, and of the Holy Roman Empire; Count and Prince of Habsburg, Flanders, Tyrol, Gorizia, Cilli, Artois, etc.; Count Palatine of Burgundy, Hainault, Holland, Zeeland, Pfirt, Kyburg, Namur and Zutphen, etc.; Prince of Swabia; Lord of Friesland, the March of the Veneti, Portenau, Molln, Salzburg, Utrecht and Mechelen, etc.; to the Father of the Fatherland, to be ever revered: life and victory.
